name: MonarchProvenance
title: Provenance
wrapsNative: HStack of Text in TimelineView(.everyMinute), inside Link when it has a URL
summary: Where a value came from and how fresh it is, such as "Registry · 2 hours ago", as a small chip or inline text.
whenToUse: Next to a value the app did not get from the person: imported, fetched from a registry, computed.
whenNotToUse: For the freshness of a whole data set with a refresh button, use MonarchFreshnessIndicator.
api: init(_ source: String, checkedAt: Date? = nil, systemImage: String? = nil, url: URL? = nil, variant: MonarchProvenanceVariant = .chip, labels: MonarchProvenanceLabels = MonarchProvenanceLabels())
struct MonarchProvenanceLabels { var source: (@Sendable (String) -> String)?; var checked: (@Sendable (String) -> String)? }

options.name: source
options.description: Where the value came from, already localised. Nothing is drawn when it is empty.

options.name: checkedAt
options.description: When the value was fetched, checked or computed; shown as relative time.

options.name: systemImage
options.description: A decorative SF Symbol before the text.

options.name: url
options.description: Turns the note into a link to the source record. Only http, https and mailto URLs are opened.

options.name: variant
options.description: chip is a small bordered tag; inline is plain muted text.

states.name: link
states.description: The source is underlined in the link colour and the note opens the URL.

appearance: Caption text in the muted text colour. The chip adds the subtle background, a subtle border and the small corner radius. A linked source uses the link colour and an underline.
platformNotes: The web shows the absolute time in a tooltip on hover and focus; iOS has no hover, so VoiceOver reads the relative time that is shown. The web accepts any content as the source; here it is text. Android shares the name and the variants.
accessibility: One element read as "Source: Registry, checked 2 hours ago".
With a URL it is a link (the system link trait) with a 44-point touch target.
Text scales with Dynamic Type and wraps.
edgeCases: An empty or blank source draws nothing.
A URL with another scheme, such as javascript: or file:, is ignored and the note is plain text.

examples.title: Next to values
Inline, opening the source
examples.code:
MonarchProvenance(
    "Companies House",
    systemImage: "building.columns",
    url: URL(string: "https://example.com/company/123"),
    variant: .inline
)
